authority: Owner requested five-second results after every completed vote; Backend assignment and Integration review in issue #119 / coordinating chat approved the checkpoint interpretation.

decisions.decision: Every completed Captain election, including every runoff, release vote and Jail vote opens a synchronized five-second server result. All-abstain votes have a result; skipped votes have none.
Lock ballots at closure and publish only the existing aggregate tally, durable result identity, original vote phase/round, exact timestamps and explicit outcome. Never publish individual ballots.

Apply the vote-specific Captain/release/Jail effect at closure; defer continuation and registered round resolution until the result deadline. Captain tie continues to a full runoff; release continues to a full Jail vote; Jail continues through registered attacks/actions, Rescue, Supplier, placements/reveals and victory in existing order. Show the result before any terminal roles/Code summary.
No gameplay commands or Code input during the result. Host abort remains available. The next phase receives its full duration at actual server transition time; the display never consumes that clock.

First closure/continuation is durable and replayable. Duplicate/stale tasks, receipts and reconnect do not restart committed windows. A first late valid repair opens the next full window at its actual transition time.

version_policy: Only new creation pins select this tuple after affected Frontend/manifest adoption. All four historical tuples, assignments, deals, matches, receipts, replay and asset pins retain their exact behavior. No migration.
contract_review: Protocol 2 exact-tuple gating with VOTE_RESULT 5000ms and required/nullable voteResult only on new tuples; affected Frontend review before consumer adoption.
